newsitem.title: MEXICO: Citibank Mexico to open branch in Guadalajara.
newsitem.headline: Citibank Mexico to open branch in Guadalajara.

text.p: Citibank Mexico, the Mexican banking arm of Citicorp, plans to open a branch in this western city, the company said in a statement.
"As part of a pilot project that aims to convert Citibank into a bank with more local presence...the Citibank Guadalajara branch will be inaugurated," the statement said.
The opening is planned for June 16. Citibank already has Mexican operations in Mexico City and in the north industrial powerhouse of Monterrey.
